build_inputs.angles:
- Lead on this: BMW built it out of the M3 and M4 parts bin. Aluminium control arms, axles and suspension hardware from the bigger M cars, bolted under the smallest body they had - which is why people started calling it the spiritual successor to the E30 M3.
- Cover that this is the end of a line: it is the last M car built around the N55 engine. Months after this one was made the M2 Competition arrived with the S55 from the M3 and M4, and the N55 never powered an M car again.
- For the head-to-head use the 2019 BMW M2 Competition - 405 hp against this car's 365, the same shell with the M4's engine dropped into it.

history.fact: The BMW M2 (2016–2018) was powered by a turbocharged 3.0-litre N55B30T0 straight-six engine rated at 272 kW (365 hp) at 6,500 rpm and 465 N⋅m (343 lb⋅ft) between 1,450 and 4,750 rpm, with an overboost function temporarily increasing torque to 500 N⋅m (369 lb⋅ft).

scenes.headline: Aluminum Parts Bin
scenes.narration: Aluminum control arms and axles from this one M3 and M4 underpin the M2, making it light and agile.

scenes.headline: Value
scenes.narration: Originally priced around $55,000, these M2s go for about $45,000 today, reflecting a modest depreciation rate. With 365 horsepower, it accelerates from zero to sixty in just 4 seconds.

scenes.headline: Sport Pedals

scenes.headline: End of N55 Era
scenes.narration: 2018 marked the last year for the N55 engine in the M lineup, paving the way for the S55 in the M2 Competition. The M2 packs a turbocharged 3.0-liter I6 under its hood.

scenes.headline: Legacy & Value
scenes.narration: Celebrated as a spiritual successor to the E30 M3, it's revered for its dynamic balance and driving pleasure.

sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2018 BMW M2, finished in Long Beach Blue Metallic with a black interior. This M2 is equipped with the desirable 6-speed manual transmission, and the odometer currently displays approximately 28,700 miles. The attached Carfax vehicle history report contains a reporting gap from 2020 to 2024, though it shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies during the given time period. According to the build sheet provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes the Executive Package, 19-inch wheels, headlight washers, a power sunroof, Dakota leather upholstery, power-adjustable and heated front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, and a Harman/Kardon sound system. The seller reports no notable modifications. The BMW M2 was introduced for the 2016 model year as a high-performance variant of the 2 Series coupe. It was developed to offer a compact, rear-wheel-drive platform with enhanced driving dynamics, advanced technology, and a motorsports-inspired design. The M2 quickly became popular among enthusiasts for its engaging handling and strong performance. Power comes from an N55 3.0-liter turbocharged inline-6, rated at 365 horsepower and 343 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual transmission.
